notes:
Dahu 0.89.0 beta for Windows x64.

### Viewport and interaction
- Five explicit display modes: Shaded, Shaded + Edges, Ghosted, Ghosted + Edges and Wireframe. Edge-free modes retain surface tint and silhouette feedback when selecting whole objects.
- Visibility-aware snaps in opaque shaded views and improved handling of edges behind surfaces.
- Radius and Diameter reuse compatible preselected geometry.
- Touchpad navigation continues over overlays and the gumball; pinch zoom stays in the modelling viewport. Extrude no longer recentres the view automatically.

### Icons and toolbar
- Filled, shaded icon families: amber curves, blue surfaces, green solids and purple meshes, with matching light/dark palettes.
- Corrected fill alignment, Boolean result regions and visible-face mesh triangulation.
- Separate Surfaces, Solids and Meshes toolbar sections. Surface blends are separate from solid edge finishes; Shell belongs to Solids. Remembered tool choices are preserved.
- Dedicated document icon featuring the official Dahu logo, distinct from the application icon. File icons take effect after installing the update.

### Validation and installation
138 automated workflow checks passed, plus native desktop and signed-updater verification. The updater verification uses a dry run and does not install the package.

The Windows installer is not Authenticode-signed: on first install, Windows may require More info > Run anyway. Corresponding source is included with this beta.
